Why: Experimental study of pressure effects on a known magnetic Weyl semimetal.

Tags: #experiment #Weyl #topology

Abstract: Magnetic materials with nontrivial band topology combine key concepts of modern solid-state physics and are expected to broaden the range of emergent quantum phases. At the same time, external pressure has proven to be a viable tool in manipulating the band topology and magnetism.
